title: Rice, white, with peas and carrots

content.title: About
content.content: Rice, white, with peas and carrots is a ready‑to‑eat dish that combines boiled white rice, green peas, and carrots. It is a nutritious and balanced meal often served as a side or light lunch.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The combination of rice, peas, and carrots offers a variety of flavors and textures.
The dish is traditionally popular in Asian and Mediterranean cuisines.
Peas provide a good source of plant protein, while carrots are rich in beta‑carotene.
It can be easily prepared at home and stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Variations may include spices such as turmeric or cumin to enhance flavor.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: White rice supplies energy through slowly digestible carbohydrates.

items.title: Rich in plant protein
items.content: Peas add a significant amount of protein beneficial for muscles and tissues.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Carrots contain vitamin A (beta‑carotene), vitamin K, and potassium, supporting vision and immunity.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Fiber from peas and carrots promotes healthy bowel function.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The dish contains virtually no fat, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Pea allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to peas.

items.title: High glycemic index of rice
items.content: White rice can raise blood sugar quickly, so people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

items.title: Sodium content in prepared dish
items.content: If seasoned with salt, total sodium intake should be considered.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve hot as a standalone meal, a side to meat or fish, or incorporate into salads. Add soy sauce, herbs, or spices for extra flavor if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. For longer storage, freeze for up to 2 months, thawing in the fridge before consumption.
